biggest_catch: The $400 tier requires the Performance Select package with $5,000 in direct deposits within 60 days — users who open the standard Virtual Wallet by mistake get only $100. Eligibility also excludes anyone who has (or recently had) a PNC consumer checking account.
catches: $400 is for Virtual Wallet WITH Performance Select ($5,000 qualifying direct deposits within 60 days); standard Virtual Wallet pays only $100 ($500 direct deposit within 60 days).
Qualifying direct deposit must be a workplace payroll direct deposit (or other qualifying ACH credit) — transfers, wires, P2P payments (Zelle/Venmo), branch/ATM/mobile/mail deposits do NOT count.

Ineligible if any account signer: has an existing PNC consumer checking account, closed a PNC consumer checking account within the past 12 months, or was a primary signer on an account that received a PNC premium within the past 24 months.
Performance Select has a $25 monthly service charge unless waived — check the waiver rules before choosing it.
Offer valid 9/1/2026–1/7/2027 and may vary by market; the offer must be opened via the bonus offer page.
Account must remain open and in good standing through payout.

steps: Go to the official PNC bonus page https://pnc.com/en/personal-banking/banking/checking/bonus-offer.html and confirm the offer is live (valid through 1/7/2027).
Open a new Virtual Wallet WITH Performance Select account directly from the offer page — not the standard Virtual Wallet (which only pays $100).

Within the first 60 days, receive a total of $5,000 in qualifying direct deposits into the Spend account — workplace payroll direct deposit is the safe path (Zelle, transfers, and mobile deposits do NOT count).
Keep the account open and in good standing until the bonus is paid.
To avoid the $25 monthly Performance Select charge, meet its fee-waiver criteria (or confirm the waiver rules on the account page before opening).
timing: Bonus paid after requirements are verified; account must remain open and in good standing through payout.
